ash_hounds.title: Ash Hounds
ash_hounds.description: Two lean shapes break from the hedgerow, their coats grey with ash and their eyes like coals.

ash_archers.title: Ash Archers
ash_archers.description: Two raiders climb the blackened hedgerow and loose arrows through the falling ash.

ash_surge.title: The Ash Squall
ash_surge.description: A shrieking wall of cinders rolls down the path. There is no shelter ahead, only the long run to the mill.

objective.description: Hold the Ash Path until the squall passes.
objective.success: The squall passes. The Ash Path is clear.
objective.failure: The ash storm drives you back.

hazards.name: Cinder Gust
hazards.description: Hot ash scours every exposed inch of skin.

cinder_raiders.title: Cinder Raiders
cinder_raiders.description: A bandit chief and two ash-smeared raiders block the cart track, axes already drawn.

ash_warden.title: The Ash Warden
ash_warden.description: A figure of cinders and iron rises from the furnace mouth, flanked by two wights that still remember being mill hands.

objective.description: Break the Ash Warden before its wights drag you down.
objective.success: The Ash Warden crumbles; the wights lose their purpose.
objective.failure: The Ash Warden's bargain is sealed.

hazards.name: Cinder Wind
hazards.description: The furnace breathes a wave of hot ash across the vault.
